outcome: Infant HBV DNA seropositivity at delivery
cohort: 585 pregnant women and 595 newborns with high viral load hepatitis B
finding: TDF was more effective than placebo in reducing vertical transmission of hepatitis B, infant HBV DNA seropositivity at delivery, severe maternal ALT flares during pregnancy, and improved HBV DNA suppression at delivery in pregnant women with high viral load hepatitis B.
